Canadian-American Hemp Flag Exchange Scheduled For ‘99 Santa Cruz Industrial Hemp Expo

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

PANEL SERIES TOPICS ANNOUNCED FOR ‘99 SANTA CRUZ INDUSTRIAL HEMP EXPO

CANADIAN-AMERICAN HEMP FLAG EXCHANGE SCHEDULED ON MAIN STAGE

The Santa Cruz Industrial Hemp Expo, slated for Saturday and Sunday, March 20 and 21 at the Civic Auditorium in Santa Cruz, California is announcing its panel series topics for the ‘99 show. Panels are in the ABC Room at the Civic. Transcripts will be available late spring.

A Canadian-American Hemp Flag Exchange is scheduled for 12:30 PM Saturday on the Main Stage. Representing Canada is Linda Scharfe, owner of Simply Hemp in Cantley, Quebec. Representing the USA is Lopi La Roe, owner of Headspace Hemp Hats in Santa Cruz, California.

Scheduled panel series topics are:

Saturday 1 - 1:50 PM "Canada ‘99: Hemp In Practice"

Saturday 2 - 2:50 PM "Hemp Body Care Products"

Saturday 4 - 4:50 PM "Hemp Food & Nutrition"

Saturday 5 - 5:50 PM "Hemp Clothing"

Sunday 12 - 12:50 PM "Hemp Paper"

Sunday 1 - 1:50 PM "Hemp Products Marketing ‘99"

Sunday 2 - 2:50 PM "Hemp Politics ‘99"

Sunday 4 - 4:50 PM "Industrial Hemp’s Next 3 Years"

Over 50 booths, live music, a hemp fashion show, a hemp house, hemp foods and beverages, educational and historical exhibits, videos, speakers and panel discussions are featured. Attendance of 6000 for the two-day event is expected. Admission is $5 per day.

For more information call the Hemp Expo’s publicity voicemail at (831)

425-3003, or visit on the web at
